      job_config:
        type: string
        required: true
      image_tag:
        type: string
        required: false
        default: "latest"
    outputs:
      job_name:
        description: "Kubernetes Job name"
        value: ${{ jobs.batch.outputs.job_name }}
      rows_scored:
        description: "Number of rows scored"
        value: ${{ jobs.batch.outputs.rows_scored }}

jobs:
  # ── Validate job config ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  validate:
    name: Validate job config
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Check job config exists
        run: |
          if [ ! -f "${{ inputs.job_config }}" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: Job config not found: ${{ inputs.job_config }}"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Validate YAML schema
        run: |
          pip install pyyaml --quiet
          python - <<'EOF'
          import yaml, sys
          with open("${{ inputs.job_config }}") as fh:
              cfg = yaml.safe_load(fh)
          required = ["job_name", "model", "input", "output"]
          for k in required:
              if k not in cfg:
                  print(f"Missing required field: {k}")
                  sys.exit(1)
          print("Schema valid.")
          EOF

  # ── Submit batch job ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  batch:
    name: Run batch job (${{ inputs.model_name }} / ${{ inputs.environment }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: validate
    environment: ${{ inputs.environment == 'production' && 'production' || '' }}
    outputs:
      job_name: ${{ steps.submit.outputs.job_name }}
      rows_scored: ${{ steps.wait.outputs.rows_scored }}

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Configure kubectl
        uses: azure/k8s-set-context@v4
        with:
          method:     kubeconfig
          kubeconfig: ${{ secrets.KUBECONFIG }}

      - name: Create job ConfigMap from config file
        id: configmap
        run: |
          NAMESPACE="${{ inputs.model_name }}-${{ inputs.environment }}"
          kubectl create namespace "$NAMESPACE" --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
          kubectl create configmap batch-job-config \
            --namespace "$NAMESPACE" \
            --from-file=job.yaml=${{ inputs.job_config }} \
            --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -

      - name: Submit Kubernetes Job
        id: submit
        run: |
          MODEL="${{ inputs.model_name }}"
          ENV="${{ inputs.environment }}"
          IMAGE_TAG="${{ inputs.image_tag }}"
          RUN_ID="${{ github.run_id }}"
          NAMESPACE="${MODEL}-${ENV}"
          JOB_NAME="${MODEL}-batch-${RUN_ID}"

          sed "s/batch-inference-job/${JOB_NAME}/g; \
               s/model-name: fraud-detection/model-name: ${MODEL}/g; \
               s/environment: production/environment: ${ENV}/g; \
               s|ghcr.io/my-org/batch-scorer:latest|ghcr.io/${{ github.repository_owner }}/batch-scorer:${IMAGE_TAG}|g; \
               s/namespace: fraud-detection-production/namespace: ${NAMESPACE}/g" \
               cd/kubernetes/batch/batch-job.yaml | kubectl apply -f -

          echo "job_name=${JOB_NAME}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "namespace=${NAMESPACE}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Wait for job completion
        id: wait
        timeout-minutes: 240
        run: |
          JOB_NAME="${{ steps.submit.outputs.job_name }}"
          NAMESPACE="${{ inputs.model_name }}-${{ inputs.environment }}"
          echo "Waiting for job: $JOB_NAME in namespace: $NAMESPACE"

          while true; do
            STATUS=$(kubectl get job "$JOB_NAME" -n "$NAMESPACE" \
              -o jsonpath='{.status.conditions[0].type}' 2>/dev/null || echo "Pending")

            if [ "$STATUS" = "Complete" ]; then
              echo "Job completed successfully."
              echo "rows_scored=$(kubectl logs -n $NAMESPACE -l batch.kubernetes.io/job-name=$JOB_NAME \
                | grep -oP 'rows_scored.*?(\d+)' | head -1 || echo '0')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              break
            elif [ "$STATUS" = "Failed" ]; then
              echo "Job FAILED."
              kubectl logs -n "$NAMESPACE" -l "batch.kubernetes.io/job-name=$JOB_NAME" --tail=100
              exit 1
            fi

            echo "  Status: $STATUS — waiting 30s..."
            sleep 30
          done

      - name: Upload job logs as artifact
        if: always()
        run: |
          NAMESPACE="${{ inputs.model_name }}-${{ inputs.environment }}"
          JOB_NAME="${{ steps.submit.outputs.job_name }}"
          kubectl logs -n "$NAMESPACE" -l "batch.kubernetes.io/job-name=$JOB_NAME" \
            > batch-job-logs.txt 2>&1 || true

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: batch-job-logs-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: batch-job-logs.txt
          retention-days: 30

files.name: distributed-train.yml
files.content:
# ci/github-actions/distributed-training/distributed-train.yml
# Main distributed training workflow — supports Ray, PyTorch (Kubeflow), and TFJob.
#
# TRIGGER:     workflow_dispatch, or called from a model-specific training workflow.
# INPUTS:      model_name, framework (ray|pytorch|tensorflow), num_workers, use_gpu,
#              config_path, environment
# OUTPUTS:     run_id (MLflow run ID), model_version (registered version)
# BEGINNER NOTE:
#   This workflow submits a distributed training job to Kubernetes.
#   GPU workloads must pass the gpu-approval-gate.yml gate first (enforced below).
#   On-demand GPU clusters require @platform-infra-team approval.

name: distributed-training

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      model_name:
        description: MLflow registered model name
        required: true
        type: string
      framework:
        description: "Distributed training framework"
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [ray, pytorch, tensorflow]
        default: ray
      num_workers:
        description: "Number of worker replicas"
        required: false
        default: "2"
        type: string
      use_gpu:
        description: "Request GPU nodes"
        required: false
        default: "true"
        type: string
      config_path:
        description: "Path to training config YAML"
        required: false
        default: ""
        type: string
      environment:
        description: "Target Kubernetes environment"
        required: false
        default: "dev"
        type: choice
        options: [dev, staging, production]

  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      model_name:
        type: string
        required: true
      framework:
        type: string
        required: false
        default: ray
      num_workers:
        type: string
        required: false
        default: "2"
      use_gpu:
        type: string
        required: false
        default: "true"
      config_path:
        type: string
        required: false
        default: ""
      environment:
        type: string
        required: false
        default: dev

    outputs:
      run_id:
        description: MLflow run ID
        value: ${{ jobs.submit-training.outputs.run_id }}
      model_version:
        description: MLflow registered model version
        value: ${{ jobs.submit-training.outputs.model_version }}

    secrets:
      KUBECONFIG_B64:
        required: true
      MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI:
        required: false

jobs:
  # ── GPU approval gate ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── #
  gpu-approval:
    name: GPU cost approval gate
    if: inputs.use_gpu == 'true'
    uses: ./.github/workflows/gpu-approval-gate.yml
    with:
      model_name:  ${{ inputs.model_name }}
      num_workers: ${{ inputs.num_workers }}
      environment: ${{ inputs.environment }}

  # ── Submit distributed training job ─────────────────────────────────────── #
  submit-training:
    name: Submit ${{ inputs.framework }} training job
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [gpu-approval]
    if: |
      always() &&
      (needs.gpu-approval.result == 'success' || needs.gpu-approval.result == 'skipped')
    permissions:
      contents: read

    outputs:
      run_id:       ${{ steps.wait.outputs.run_id }}
      model_version: ${{ steps.wait.outputs.model_version }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python 3.11
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"
          cache: pip

      - name: Install kubectl + kustomize
        run: |
          curl -sLO "https://dl.k8s.io/release/$(curl -L -s https://dl.k8s.io/release/stable.txt)/bin/linux/amd64/kubectl"
          chmod +x kubectl
          sudo mv kubectl /usr/local/bin/
          curl -sLO "https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kustomize/releases/download/kustomize%2Fv5.4.1/kustomize_v5.4.1_linux_amd64.tar.gz"
          tar -xzf kustomize_*.tar.gz
          sudo mv kustomize /usr/local/bin/

      - name: Configure kubectl
        run: |
          mkdir -p "$HOME/.kube"
          echo "${{ secrets.KUBECONFIG_B64 }}" | base64 -d > "$HOME/.kube/config"
          chmod 600 "$HOME/.kube/config"

      - name: Determine config path
        id: config
        run: |
          CONFIG="${{ inputs.config_path }}"
          if [ -z "$CONFIG" ]; then
            CONFIG="training/config/${{ inputs.model_name }}.yaml"
          fi
          echo "path=$CONFIG" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Generate namespace
        id: ns
        run: |
          NS="${{ inputs.model_name }}-${{ inputs.environment }}"
          # Kubernetes namespace names must be lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens.
          NS=$(echo "$NS" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | tr '_' '-')
          echo "namespace=$NS" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Submit Ray training job
        if: inputs.framework == 'ray'
        run: |
          NS="${{ steps.ns.outputs.namespace }}"
          kubectl get namespace "$NS" 2>/dev/null || kubectl create namespace "$NS"

          # Patch the RayJob with current image and replica count.
          cat cd/kubernetes/training/ray-job.yaml | \
            sed "s/model-placeholder/${{ inputs.model_name }}/g" | \
            sed "s/replicas: 2/replicas: ${{ inputs.num_workers }}/g" | \
            kubectl apply -n "$NS" -f -

      - name: Submit PyTorch training job
        if: inputs.framework == 'pytorch'
        run: |
          NS="${{ steps.ns.outputs.namespace }}"
          kubectl get namespace "$NS" 2>/dev/null || kubectl create namespace "$NS"

          cat cd/kubernetes/training/pytorch-job.yaml | \
            sed "s/model-placeholder/${{ inputs.model_name }}/g" | \
            sed "s/replicas: 3/replicas: ${{ inputs.num_workers }}/g" | \
            kubectl apply -n "$NS" -f -

      - name: Submit TF training job
        if: inputs.framework == 'tensorflow'
        run: |
          NS="${{ steps.ns.outputs.namespace }}"
          kubectl get namespace "$NS" 2>/dev/null || kubectl create namespace "$NS"

          cat cd/kubernetes/training/tf-job.yaml | \
            sed "s/model-placeholder/${{ inputs.model_name }}/g" | \
            sed "s/replicas: 3/replicas: ${{ inputs.num_workers }}/g" | \
            kubectl apply -n "$NS" -f -

      - name: Wait for training completion
        id: wait
        timeout-minutes: 360
        run: |
          NS="${{ steps.ns.outputs.namespace }}"

          echo "Waiting for training job to complete in namespace $NS ..."
          # Poll every 60s for up to 6 hours.
          for i in $(seq 1 360); do
            STATUS=$(kubectl get pods -n "$NS" \
              -l model-name=${{ inputs.model_name }} \
              --no-headers -o custom-columns="STATUS:.status.phase" \
              | sort | uniq)
            echo "Status at iteration $i: $STATUS"

            if echo "$STATUS" | grep -q "Failed"; then
              echo "Training job FAILED"
              exit 1
            fi

            if [ "$(echo "$STATUS" | grep -c "^Succeeded$")" -gt 0 ] && \
               [ "$(echo "$STATUS" | grep -v "Succeeded" | grep -v "^$" | wc -l)" -eq 0 ]; then
              echo "Training job SUCCEEDED"
              # Output placeholders — in practice, read from MLflow via API or artifact.
              echo "run_id=pending" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "model_version=pending" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              exit 0
            fi

            sleep 60
          done

          echo "Training job timed out"
          exit 1

files.name: gpu-approval-gate.yml
files.content:
# ci/github-actions/distributed-training/gpu-approval-gate.yml
# Human-approval gate for GPU training jobs.
#
# TRIGGER:     workflow_call
# INPUTS:      model_name, num_workers, environment
# OUTPUTS:     approved (true/false)
# BEGINNER NOTE:
#   GPU training on on-demand nodes is expensive (e.g., H100 ~ $4.76/hr).
#   This gate estimates the GPU cost and requires @platform-infra-team approval
#   when the estimated cost exceeds $500 or when the environment is staging/production.
#   Dev spot jobs under $500 auto-approve.

name: gpu-approval-gate

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      model_name:
        type: string
        required: true
      num_workers:
        type: string
        required: false
        default: "2"
      environment:
        type: string
        required: false
        default: dev

    outputs:
      approved:
        description: "'true' if GPU use is approved"
        value: ${{ jobs.gpu-gate.outputs.approved }}

jobs:
  gpu-gate:
    name: GPU cost gate — ${{ inputs.model_name }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Require human approval for staging/production GPU jobs.
    environment: ${{ (inputs.environment == 'staging' || inputs.environment == 'production') && 'gpu-approval' || '' }}
    permissions:
      contents: read

    outputs:
      approved: ${{ steps.estimate.outputs.approved }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Estimate GPU cost
        id: estimate
        run: |
          python - << 'PY'
          import yaml, os

          rates_path = "finops/data/instance-rates.yaml"
          try:
              with open(rates_path) as fh:
                  rates = yaml.safe_load(fh)
          except FileNotFoundError:
              rates = {}

          gpu_per_hr  = float(rates.get("gpu_per_unit_per_hour", 2.10))
          num_workers = int("${{ inputs.num_workers }}")
          env         = "${{ inputs.environment }}"
          # Assume spot discount for dev, on-demand for staging/prod.
          if env == "dev":
              spot_discount = float(rates.get("spot_discount_factor", 0.70))
              effective_rate = gpu_per_hr * spot_discount
          else:
              effective_rate = gpu_per_hr

          # Assume max 24-hour training run for estimation.
          estimated_cost = num_workers * effective_rate * 24

          summary = (
              f"{num_workers} GPU(s) × ${effective_rate:.2f}/hr × 24h "
              f"= ${estimated_cost:.2f} est. ({env})"
          )
          print(summary)

          with open(os.environ["GITHUB_OUTPUT"], "a") as f:
              f.write(f"estimated_cost={estimated_cost:.2f}\n")
              f.write(f"cost_summary={summary}\n")
              f.write("approved=true\n")

          if estimated_cost > 500:
              print(f"WARNING: Estimated cost ${estimated_cost:.2f} > $500 threshold.")
              print("Ensure @platform-infra-team has reviewed this job.")
          PY

      - name: Print cost estimate
        run: |
          echo "GPU cost estimate: ${{ steps.estimate.outputs.cost_summary }}"
          echo ""
          echo "If this exceeds your budget, consider:"
          echo "  1. Reducing num_workers"
          echo "  2. Using spot instances (dev only)"
          echo "  3. Updating the model budget file in finops/budgets/"

files.name: fairness-gate.yml
files.content:
# ci/github-actions/fairness/fairness-gate.yml
# Reusable fairness evaluation gate workflow.
#
# TRIGGER:     workflow_call (called by promotion-gates.yml or evaluate.yml)
# INPUTS:      model_name, model_version, test_data_path, fairness_config_path,
#              gate_mode (warn | fail)
# OUTPUTS:     fairness_passed (true/false), fairness_summary (human-readable)
# BEGINNER NOTE:
#   This workflow downloads the model, runs fairness/evaluate.py, and checks
#   whether all fairness metrics are within the thresholds defined in the
#   model's policy/fairness/<model-name>-fairness.yaml config.
#   In dev mode (gate_mode=warn) it never blocks; in staging/production it fails
#   the calling workflow if any threshold is violated.

name: fairness-gate

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      model_name:
        description: MLflow registered model name
        type: string
        required: true
      model_version:
        description: MLflow model version to evaluate
        type: string
        required: true
      test_data_path:
        description: Relative path to test Parquet file in the repo
        type: string
        default: data/test_features.parquet
      fairness_config_path:
        description: Relative path to fairness config YAML
        type: string
        default: ""   # empty = auto-detect policy/fairness/<model_name>-fairness.yaml
      gate_mode:
        description: "warn (log only) or fail (block on violation)"
        type: string
        default: fail
      explainability:
        description: "Also run SHAP explainability report (true/false)"
        type: string
        default: "true"

    outputs:
      fairness_passed:
        description: "'true' if all fairness thresholds passed"
        value: ${{ jobs.fairness.outputs.fairness_passed }}
      fairness_summary:
        description: Human-readable summary of fairness results
        value: ${{ jobs.fairness.outputs.fairness_summary }}

    secrets:
      MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI:
        required: true
      DVC_AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID:
        required: false
      DVC_AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY:
        required: false

jobs:
  fairness:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read

    outputs:
      fairness_passed: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.fairness_passed }}
      fairness_summary: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.fairness_summary }}

    steps:
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
      # 1. CHECKOUT + SETUP
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python 3.11
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"
          cache: pip

      - name: Install fairness dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --quiet --upgrade pip
          pip install --quiet \
            "fairlearn>=0.10" \
            "shap>=0.44" \
            "mlflow>=2.11" \
            "pandas>=2.0" \
            "scikit-learn>=1.4" \
            "numpy>=1.26" \
            "matplotlib>=3.8" \
            "pyyaml>=6.0" \
            "dvc[s3]>=3.0"

      # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
      # 2. PULL TEST DATA VIA DVC
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
      - name: Pull test data
        env:
          MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI:   ${{ secrets.MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI }}
          AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID:     ${{ secrets.DVC_AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ secrets.DVC_AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
        run: dvc pull ${{ inputs.test_data_path }}

      # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
      # 3. RESOLVE FAIRNESS CONFIG PATH
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
      - name: Resolve fairness config path
        id: config
        run: |
          CONFIG="${{ inputs.fairness_config_path }}"
          if [ -z "$CONFIG" ]; then
            CONFIG="policy/fairness/${{ inputs.model_name }}-fairness.yaml"
          fi
          if [ ! -f "$CONFIG" ]; then
            echo "WARNING: Fairness config not found at $CONFIG — using default thresholds."
            # Write a minimal default config so the gate can proceed.
            cat > /tmp/default-fairness.yaml << 'EOF'
          model_name: ${{ inputs.model_name }}
          label_column: label
          sensitive_features: []
          thresholds:
            disparate_impact_ratio: 0.80
            equalised_odds_difference: 0.10
            fnr_disparity: 0.10
          EOF
            CONFIG="/tmp/default-fairness.yaml"
            echo "used_default=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          echo "config_path=$CONFIG" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
      # 4. RUN FAIRNESS GATE
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
      - name: Run fairness evaluation
        id: gate
        env:
          MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI: ${{ secrets.MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI }}
        run: |
          python fairness/evaluate.py \
            --model-uri   "models:/${{ inputs.model_name }}/${{ inputs.model_version }}" \
            --test-data   "${{ inputs.test_data_path }}" \
            --config      "${{ steps.config.outputs.config_path }}" \
            --report-path "reports/fairness/${{ inputs.model_name }}-v${{ inputs.model_version }}.json"

          EXIT_CODE=$?

          # Parse report for summary
          SUMMARY=$(python - << 'PY'
          import json, sys
          try:
              with open("reports/fairness/${{ inputs.model_name }}-v${{ inputs.model_version }}.json") as f:
                  r = json.load(f)
              passed = r.get("passed", False)
              violations = r.get("violations", [])
              results = r.get("results", {})
              lines = [f"Fairness gate: {'PASS' if passed else 'FAIL'}"]
              for feat, metrics in results.items():
                  lines.append(
                      f"  {feat}: DI={metrics['disparate_impact_ratio']} "
                      f"EOD={metrics['equalised_odds_difference']} "
                      f"FNR_disp={metrics['fnr_disparity']}"
                  )
              if violations:
                  lines.append("Violations:")
                  for v in violations:
                      lines.append(f"  {v}")
              print(" | ".join(lines))
          except Exception as e:
              print(f"Could not parse report: {e}")
          PY
          )

          echo "fairness_summary=$SUMMARY" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

          if [ $EXIT_CODE -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "fairness_passed=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "fairness_passed=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            if [ "${{ inputs.gate_mode }}" = "fail" ]; then
              echo "Fairness gate FAILED (gate_mode=fail). Blocking promotion." >&2
              exit 1
            else
              echo "Fairness gate FAILED but gate_mode=warn — continuing."
            fi
          fi

      # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
      # 5. SHAP EXPLAINABILITY REPORT (optional)
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
      - name: Run SHAP explainability
        if: ${{ inputs.explainability == 'true' }}
        env:
          MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI: ${{ secrets.MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI }}
        run: |
          python fairness/explainability.py \
            --model-uri   "models:/${{ inputs.model_name }}/${{ inputs.model_version }}" \
            --test-data   "${{ inputs.test_data_path }}" \
            --output-dir  "reports/explainability/${{ inputs.model_name }}-v${{ inputs.model_version }}/"

      # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
      # 6. UPLOAD REPORTS AS ARTIFACTS
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
      - name: Upload fairness + explainability reports
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: fairness-reports-${{ inputs.model_name }}-v${{ inputs.model_version }}
          path: reports/
          retention-days: 90

files.name: federated-eval.yml
files.content:
##
# Trigger:  workflow_call (from federated-train.yml) or workflow_dispatch (manual)
# Inputs:
#   model_name    - registered model name in MLflow
#   model_version - model version to evaluate (registered after final aggregation round)
# Outputs:
#   accuracy      - global test set accuracy (float string)
#   eval_passed   - "true" if accuracy meets the Production gate
# Beginner note:
#   This workflow evaluates the globally aggregated model on a held-out test set
#   held by the coordinator.  No party data is used.  The model must pass this
#   gate before it can be promoted to Production.
##

name: Federated Evaluation

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      model_name:
        description: "Registered model name in MLflow"
        required: true
        type: string
      model_version:
        description: "Model version to evaluate"
        required: true
        type: string

  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      model_name:
        required: true
        type: string
      model_version:
        required: true
        type: string
    outputs:
      accuracy:
        description: "Global test set accuracy"
        value: ${{ jobs.evaluate.outputs.accuracy }}
      eval_passed:
        description: "true if accuracy gate passed"
        value: ${{ jobs.evaluate.outputs.eval_passed }}

jobs:
  evaluate:
    name: Evaluate Global Model
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      accuracy: ${{ steps.eval.outputs.accuracy }}
      eval_passed: ${{ steps.eval.outputs.eval_passed }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python 3.11
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"
          cache: pip

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --no-cache-dir \
            mlflow==2.14.2 \
            torch>=2.3.0 \
            numpy>=1.26 \
            scikit-learn>=1.5

      - name: Configure MLflow
        run: |
          echo "MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI=${{ secrets.MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Evaluate global model
        id: eval
        env:
          MODEL_NAME: ${{ inputs.model_name }}
          MODEL_VERSION: ${{ inputs.model_version }}
          ACCURACY_GATE: "0.80"
          GLOBAL_TEST_DATA: "data/global_test.parquet"
        run: |
          python -c "
          import os, mlflow
          import pandas as pd
          from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
          import numpy as np

          model = mlflow.pytorch.load_model(
              f\"models:/{os.environ['MODEL_NAME']}/{os.environ['MODEL_VERSION']}\"
          )
          model.eval()

          test_df = pd.read_parquet(os.environ['GLOBAL_TEST_DATA'])
          import torch
          X = torch.tensor(test_df.drop('label', axis=1).values, dtype=torch.float32)
          y_true = test_df['label'].values

          with torch.no_grad():
              logits = model(X)
              y_pred = logits.argmax(dim=1).numpy()

          accuracy = float(accuracy_score(y_true, y_pred))
          gate = float(os.environ['ACCURACY_GATE'])
          passed = accuracy >= gate

          print(f'Global accuracy: {accuracy:.4f} (gate={gate}) passed={passed}')

          with open(os.environ['GITHUB_OUTPUT'], 'a') as f:
              f.write(f'accuracy={accuracy:.4f}\n')
              f.write(f'eval_passed={str(passed).lower()}\n')
          "

      - name: Fail if accuracy gate not met
        if: steps.eval.outputs.eval_passed == 'false'
        run: |
          echo "::error::Federated model accuracy gate FAILED."
          echo "Global accuracy ${{ steps.eval.outputs.accuracy }} is below the required gate."
          exit 1

files.name: federated-train.yml
files.content:
##
# Trigger:  workflow_dispatch (manual) or workflow_call (from orchestration workflows)
# Inputs:
#   model_name      - registered model name in MLflow (e.g. "fraud-detector")
#   rounds          - number of federated training rounds to run (default: 10)
#   algorithm       - aggregation algorithm: "fedavg" (default) or "fedprox"
#   party_endpoints - JSON array of HTTPS party endpoints (e.g. '["https://party-a:8443"]')
# Outputs:
#   global_model_version - MLflow model version registered after the final round
# Beginner note:
#   This workflow runs the federated coordinator as a Kubernetes Job.
#   Each round is a separate MLflow run tagged `federated_round: <N>`.
#   Raw training data NEVER leaves the party environments.
#   Only model weights travel between coordinator and parties over TLS 1.3.
##

name: Federated Training

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      model_name:
        description: "Registered model name in MLflow"
        required: true
        type: string
      rounds:
        description: "Number of federated training rounds"
        required: false
        default: "10"
        type: string
      algorithm:
        description: "Aggregation algorithm (fedavg | fedprox)"
        required: false
        default: "fedavg"
        type: choice
        options:
          - fedavg
          - fedprox
      party_endpoints:
        description: "JSON array of HTTPS party endpoint URLs"
        required: true
        type: string

  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      model_name:
        required: true
        type: string
      rounds:
        required: false
        default: "10"
        type: string
      algorithm:
        required: false
        default: "fedavg"
        type: string
      party_endpoints:
        required: true
        type: string
    outputs:
      global_model_version:
        description: "MLflow model version registered after the final federated round"
        value: ${{ jobs.coordinate.outputs.global_model_version }}

jobs:
  coordinate:
    name: Run Federated Coordinator
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      global_model_version: ${{ steps.run-coordinator.outputs.global_model_version }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python 3.11
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"
          cache: pip

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --no-cache-dir \
            mlflow==2.14.2 \
            torch>=2.3.0 \
            numpy>=1.26 \
            httpx>=0.27 \
            fastapi>=0.111 \
            uvicorn>=0.30

      - name: Configure MLflow
        run: |
          echo "MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI=${{ secrets.MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Run federated coordinator
        id: run-coordinator
        env:
          MODEL_NAME: ${{ inputs.model_name }}
          ROUNDS: ${{ inputs.rounds }}
          ALGORITHM: ${{ inputs.algorithm }}
          PARTY_ENDPOINTS: ${{ inputs.party_endpoints }}
          FEDERATED_TLS_VERIFY: "true"
        run: |
          python -c "
          import json, os
          from federated_learning.coordinator import FederatedCoordinator
          import torch.nn as nn

          # Placeholder: in production the model architecture is loaded from MLflow
          model = nn.Linear(10, 2)
          endpoints = json.loads(os.environ['PARTY_ENDPOINTS'])
          coordinator = FederatedCoordinator(
              model_name=os.environ['MODEL_NAME'],
              global_model=model,
              party_endpoints=endpoints,
              rounds=int(os.environ['ROUNDS']),
              algorithm=os.environ['ALGORITHM'],
          )
          coordinator.run()
          print('Federated training complete')
          "

      - name: Retrieve latest model version
        id: get-version
        env:
          MODEL_NAME: ${{ inputs.model_name }}
        run: |
          VERSION=$(python -c "
          import mlflow
          client = mlflow.tracking.MlflowClient()
          versions = client.search_model_versions(f\"name='$MODEL_NAME'\")
          latest = max(versions, key=lambda v: int(v.version))
          print(latest.version)
          ")
          echo "global_model_version=$VERSION" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  trigger-eval:
    name: Trigger Federated Evaluation
    needs: coordinate
    uses: ./.github/workflows/federated-eval.yml
    with:
      model_name: ${{ inputs.model_name }}
      model_version: ${{ needs.coordinate.outputs.global_model_version }}
    secrets: inherit

files.name: cost-budget-check.yml
files.content:
# ci/github-actions/finops/cost-budget-check.yml
# Reusable budget gate — called by promotion-gates.yml before staging/production.
#
# TRIGGER:     workflow_call
# INPUTS:      model_name, environment
# OUTPUTS:     budget_passed (true/false), budget_summary (human-readable)
# BEGINNER NOTE:
#   This workflow checks whether a model's current weekly spend is below its
#   budget limit.  If the model has no budget file, the gate passes with a
#   warning.  If it has a budget file and weekly spend > limit, the gate fails
#   and blocks promotion.

name: cost-budget-check

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      model_name:
        description: MLflow registered model name
        type: string
        required: true
      environment:
        description: Target environment (dev|staging|production)
        type: string
        required: true

    outputs:
      budget_passed:
        description: "'true' if within budget limits"
        value: ${{ jobs.budget-check.outputs.budget_passed }}
      budget_summary:
        description: Human-readable budget check summary
        value: ${{ jobs.budget-check.outputs.budget_summary }}

    secrets:
      KUBECONFIG_B64:
        required: false

jobs:
  budget-check:
    name: Budget gate — ${{ inputs.model_name }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read

    outputs:
      budget_passed: ${{ steps.check.outputs.budget_passed }}
      budget_summary: ${{ steps.check.outputs.budget_summary }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python 3.11
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"
          cache: pip

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install --quiet "pandas>=2.0" "pyyaml>=6.0"

      - name: Check budget
        id: check
        run: |
          python - << 'PY'
          import json, sys, yaml
          from pathlib import Path

          model = "${{ inputs.model_name }}"
          env   = "${{ inputs.environment }}"

          budget_path = Path(f"finops/budgets/{model}.yaml")
          if not budget_path.exists():
              print(f"No budget file for {model} — gate passes with warning.")
              print("budget_passed=true", flush=True)
              with open("$GITHUB_OUTPUT", "a") as f:
                  f.write("budget_passed=true\n")
                  f.write(f"budget_summary=No budget configured for {model}\n")
              sys.exit(0)

          with open(budget_path) as fh:
              budget = yaml.safe_load(fh)

          weekly_limit = budget.get("weekly_limit_usd")
          if not weekly_limit:
              print("No weekly_limit_usd in budget file — gate passes.")
              with open("$GITHUB_OUTPUT", "a") as f:
                  f.write("budget_passed=true\n")
                  f.write(f"budget_summary=No weekly limit configured for {model}\n")
              sys.exit(0)

          # Find most recent weekly report
          reports = sorted(Path("finops/reports/weekly").glob("*-weekly-report.json"), reverse=True)
          if not reports:
              print("No weekly reports found — gate passes (no data).")
              with open("$GITHUB_OUTPUT", "a") as f:
                  f.write("budget_passed=true\n")
                  f.write("budget_summary=No weekly cost data available\n")
              sys.exit(0)

          with open(reports[0]) as fh:
              weekly = json.load(fh)

          model_cost = sum(
              row["total_cost_usd"]
              for row in weekly.get("by_model", [])
              if row.get("model_name") == model
          )

          pct = model_cost / weekly_limit * 100
          summary = (
              f"{model}: ${model_cost:.2f} / ${weekly_limit:.2f} weekly "
              f"({pct:.1f}%)"
          )
          print(summary)

          passed = model_cost <= weekly_limit
          with open("$GITHUB_OUTPUT", "a") as f:
              f.write(f"budget_passed={'true' if passed else 'false'}\n")
              f.write(f"budget_summary={summary}\n")

          if not passed:
              print(
                  f"BUDGET EXCEEDED: {model} weekly cost ${model_cost:.2f} "
                  f"> limit ${weekly_limit:.2f}",
                  file=sys.stderr,
              )
              sys.exit(1)
          PY

files.name: monthly-cost-report.yml
files.content:
# ci/github-actions/finops/monthly-cost-report.yml
# Monthly ML cost report + chargeback summary.
#
# TRIGGER:     Cron (1st of each month at 07:00 UTC) or workflow_dispatch.
# INPUTS:      month (YYYY-MM) — defaults to previous calendar month.
# OUTPUTS:     JSON + Markdown monthly report as GitHub Actions artifact.
# BEGINNER NOTE:
#   This workflow generates the chargeback report that engineering teams use
#   to review cloud spend attributed to their ML workloads. It aggregates
#   daily cost-attribution files for the previous calendar month and checks
#   each model against its monthly budget limit.

name: ml-cost-monthly-report

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 7 1 * *"   # 1st of each month at 07:00 UTC
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      month:
        description: "Month to report (YYYY-MM). Defaults to previous month."
        required: false
        default: ""

jobs:
  monthly-report:
    name: Monthly cost report
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python 3.11
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"
          cache: pip

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install --quiet "pandas>=2.0" "pyyaml>=6.0"

      - name: Resolve target month
        id: month
        run: |
          MONTH="${{ inputs.month }}"
          if [ -z "$MONTH" ]; then
            MONTH=$(date -u -d "last month" +%Y-%m 2>/dev/null || date -u -v-1m +%Y-%m)
          fi
          echo "month=$MONTH" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Generate monthly report
        run: |
          python finops/scripts/monthly-cost-report.py \
            --reports-dir finops/reports/daily/ \
            --output-dir  finops/reports/monthly/ \
            --budget-dir  finops/budgets/ \
            --month       "${{ steps.month.outputs.month }}"

      - name: Upload monthly report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: cost-monthly-${{ steps.month.outputs.month }}
          path: finops/reports/monthly/
          retention-days: 365    # keep monthly reports for 1 year (audit)

files.name: weekly-cost-report.yml
files.content:
# ci/github-actions/finops/weekly-cost-report.yml
# Weekly ML cost report + daily cost-attribution job.
#
# TRIGGER:     Cron (daily 01:00 UTC + Monday 06:00 UTC) or workflow_dispatch.
# INPUTS:      None (uses repo default paths).
# OUTPUTS:     Uploads reports as GitHub Actions artifacts (90-day retention).
# BEGINNER NOTE:
#   The daily step runs ml-cost-attribution.py every night to capture pod
#   resource usage. The weekly step (Monday only) aggregates the last 7 days
#   and checks each model against its finops/budgets/<model>.yaml limit.
#   If a model is over budget, the job exits non-zero — creating a visible
#   failure that the team must acknowledge.

name: ml-cost-weekly-report

on:
  schedule:
    # Daily cost attribution: every night at 01:00 UTC
    - cron: "0 1 * * *"
    # Weekly report: Monday at 06:00 UTC
    - cron: "0 6 * * 1"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      run_weekly:
        description: "Force weekly report generation (true/false)"
        default: "false"

jobs:
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #
  # DAILY: cost attribution snapshot
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #
  daily-attribution:
    name: Daily cost attribution
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python 3.11
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"
          cache: pip

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --quiet \
            "kubernetes>=29.0" \
            "pandas>=2.0" \
            "pyyaml>=6.0" \
            "prometheus-api-client>=0.5"

      - name: Configure kubeconfig
        env:
          KUBECONFIG_B64: ${{ secrets.KUBECONFIG_B64 }}
        run: |
          mkdir -p ~/.kube
          echo "$KUBECONFIG_B64" | base64 -d > ~/.kube/config
          chmod 600 ~/.kube/config

      - name: Run daily cost attribution
        run: |
          TODAY=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)
          python finops/scripts/ml-cost-attribution.py \
            --rates-file  finops/data/instance-rates.yaml \
            --output-path "finops/reports/daily/${TODAY}.json"

      - name: Upload daily report artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: cost-daily-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: finops/reports/daily/
          retention-days: 90

  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #
  # WEEKLY: aggregated report + budget check
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #
  weekly-report:
    name: Weekly cost report
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: daily-attribution
    # Run only on Monday or when forced via workflow_dispatch
    if: |
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.run_weekly == 'true'
      || (github.event_name == 'schedule' && startsWith(github.event.schedule, '0 6 * * 1'))
    permissions:
      contents: read

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python 3.11
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"
          cache: pip

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install --quiet "pandas>=2.0" "pyyaml>=6.0"

      - name: Download daily reports
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: cost-daily-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: finops/reports/daily/

      - name: Generate weekly report
        id: weekly
        run: |
          python finops/scripts/weekly-cost-report.py \
            --reports-dir finops/reports/daily/ \
            --output-dir  finops/reports/weekly/ \
            --budget-dir  finops/budgets/
          EXIT=$?
          echo "exit_code=$EXIT" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          exit $EXIT

      - name: Upload weekly report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: cost-weekly-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: finops/reports/weekly/
          retention-days: 90

files.name: evaluate-llm.yml
files.content:
# ci/github-actions/llmops/evaluate-llm.yml
#
# Trigger:  workflow_call (called by fine-tune.yml or promote.yml)
#           or workflow_dispatch (manual).
# Inputs:   model_name     — MLflow registered model name
#           model_version  — MLflow model version to evaluate
#           endpoint_url   — Model serving endpoint URL
# Outputs:  overall_score  — Mean benchmark score
# Beginner note:
#   Runs benchmark evaluation against a deployed LLM endpoint and logs
#   results to MLflow.  Fails if overall_score drops below the gate threshold.
---
name: LLMOps — Evaluate LLM

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      model_name:
        required: true
        type: string
      model_version:
        required: true
        type: string
      endpoint_url:
        required: true
        type: string
    outputs:
      overall_score:
        description: Mean score across all benchmarks
        value: ${{ jobs.evaluate.outputs.overall_score }}
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      model_name:
        description: MLflow registered model name
        required: true
        type: string
      model_version:
        description: MLflow model version
        required: true
        type: string
      endpoint_url:
        description: Model serving endpoint URL
        required: true
        type: string

jobs:
  evaluate:
    name: Evaluate ${{ inputs.model_name }} v${{ inputs.model_version }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60

    outputs:
      overall_score: ${{ steps.eval.outputs.overall_score }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python 3.11
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"
          cache: pip

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install --upgrade pip mlflow requests rouge-score pyyaml

      - name: Run evaluation harness
        id: eval
        env:
          MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI: ${{ secrets.MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI }}
        run: |
          python llmops/evaluation/harness.py \
            --model-name    "${{ inputs.model_name }}" \
            --model-version "${{ inputs.model_version }}" \
            --endpoint-url  "${{ inputs.endpoint_url }}" \
            --benchmarks-dir llmops/evaluation/benchmarks/ \
            | tee eval_output.txt

          # Extract overall_score from stdout
          SCORE=$(grep -oP 'Overall score: \K[\d.]+' eval_output.txt || echo "0")
          echo "overall_score=${SCORE}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Enforce score gate
        run: |
          python - <<'EOF'
          import sys
          score = float("${{ steps.eval.outputs.overall_score }}" or 0)
          threshold = 0.60  # Adjust per model requirements
          if score < threshold:
              print(f"FAIL: overall_score {score:.4f} < threshold {threshold}")
              sys.exit(1)
          print(f"PASS: overall_score {score:.4f} >= threshold {threshold}")
          EOF

files.name: fine-tune.yml
files.content:
# ci/github-actions/llmops/fine-tune.yml
#
# Trigger:  workflow_dispatch (manual), or push to branches matching 'llmops/**'
#           when files in llmops/fine_tuning/ change.
# Inputs:   model_name     — MLflow registered model name
#           base_model     — HuggingFace model ID for the base model
#           config_path    — Path to trainer config YAML
#           trainer        — lora | qlora | full (default: lora)
# Outputs:  mlflow_run_id  — MLflow run ID of the completed fine-tuning run
# Beginner note:
#   This workflow fine-tunes an LLM using LoRA, QLoRA, or full fine-tuning.
#   Adapters are stored in MLflow.  Requires GPU runner (self-hosted or Actions GPU).
---
name: LLMOps — Fine-tune

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      model_name:
        description: MLflow registered model name
        required: true
        type: string
      base_model:
        description: HuggingFace model ID or local path
        required: true
        type: string
        default: gpt2
      config_path:
        description: Path to YAML trainer config file
        required: true
        type: string
      trainer:
        description: Fine-tuning strategy
        required: false
        type: choice
        default: lora
        options: [lora, qlora, full]
  push:
    branches:
      - "llmops/**"
    paths:
      - "llmops/fine_tuning/**"

jobs:
  fine-tune:
    name: Fine-tune ${{ inputs.model_name || 'default' }} (${{ inputs.trainer || 'lora' }})
    runs-on: [self-hosted, gpu]
    timeout-minutes: 360

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python 3.11
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"
          cache: pip

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install transformers peft bitsandbytes torch datasets mlflow accelerate trl pyyaml

      - name: Run fine-tuning
        env:
          MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI: ${{ secrets.MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI }}
          HF_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.HF_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          TRAINER="${{ inputs.trainer || 'lora' }}"
          CONFIG="${{ inputs.config_path }}"

          case "$TRAINER" in
            lora)   SCRIPT="llmops/fine_tuning/lora_trainer.py" ;;
            qlora)  SCRIPT="llmops/fine_tuning/qlora_trainer.py" ;;
            full)   SCRIPT="llmops/fine_tuning/full_fine_tune.py" ;;
            *)      echo "Unknown trainer: $TRAINER"; exit 1 ;;
          esac

          python "$SCRIPT" --config "$CONFIG"

files.name: prompt-validate.yml
files.content:
# ci/github-actions/llmops/prompt-validate.yml
#
# Trigger:  pull_request touching llmops/prompts/**
#           or workflow_dispatch (manual with prompt file path input).
# Inputs:   prompt_file  — Path to the prompt YAML file to validate
# Outputs:  prompt_hash  — Content hash of the validated prompt
# Beginner note:
#   Validates a prompt template YAML file against llmops/prompts/schema.yaml and
#   registers it in MLflow on merge to main.  PRs only validate; registration
#   only runs on push to main.
---
name: LLMOps — Prompt Validate and Register

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "llmops/prompts/**"
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - "llmops/prompts/**"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      prompt_file:
        description: Path to prompt YAML file to validate/register
        required: true
        type: string

jobs:
  validate:
    name: Validate prompt templates
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python 3.11
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"
          cache: pip

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install --upgrade pip pyyaml jsonschema

      - name: Validate prompt YAML files
        run: |
          python - <<'EOF'
          import sys
          import yaml
          import jsonschema
          from pathlib import Path

          schema_path = Path("llmops/prompts/schema.yaml")
          if not schema_path.exists():
              print("SKIP: schema.yaml not found.")
              sys.exit(0)

          schema = yaml.safe_load(schema_path.read_text())
          errors = []

          target = "${{ inputs.prompt_file }}"
          if target:
              files = [Path(target)]
          else:
              files = list(Path("llmops/prompts").glob("*.yaml"))
              files = [f for f in files if f.name != "schema.yaml"]

          for f in files:
              data = yaml.safe_load(f.read_text())
              try:
                  jsonschema.validate(data, schema)
                  print(f"  PASS {f}")
              except jsonschema.ValidationError as e:
                  print(f"  FAIL {f}: {e.message}")
                  errors.append(str(f))

          if errors:
              print(f"\n{len(errors)} validation error(s).")
              sys.exit(1)
          print("\nAll prompt files are valid.")
          EOF

  register:
    name: Register prompts on merge to main
    needs: validate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python 3.11
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"
          cache: pip

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install --upgrade pip mlflow pyyaml jsonschema

      - name: Register changed prompt files
        env:
          MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI: ${{ secrets.MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI }}
        run: |
          git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD -- 'llmops/prompts/*.yaml' \
            | grep -v schema.yaml \
            | while read -r pfile; do
                echo "Registering $pfile ..."
                python - <<PYEOF
          import sys
          from pathlib import Path
          from llmops.prompts.registry import PromptRegistry
          import yaml

          p = Path("$pfile")
          data = yaml.safe_load(p.read_text())
          model_name = data.get("metadata", {}).get("model_name", p.stem.split("-")[0])
          registry = PromptRegistry()
          run_id = registry.register(model_name=model_name, prompt_file=p)
          print(f"Registered: run_id={run_id}")
          PYEOF
              done

files.name: rlhf-train.yml
files.content:
# ci/github-actions/llmops/rlhf-train.yml
#
# Trigger:  workflow_dispatch (manual).
# Inputs:   model_name         — MLflow registered model name
#           base_model         — HuggingFace model ID for reward model and policy
#           preference_dataset — Path or HuggingFace dataset ID
#           num_steps          — PPO training steps (default: 1000)
# Outputs:  reward_run_id      — MLflow run ID of the reward model training
#           ppo_run_id         — MLflow run ID of the PPO training
# Beginner note:
#   Runs the two-stage RLHF pipeline: (1) train reward model, (2) PPO fine-tune.
#   Both stages log to MLflow.  Requires GPU runner.
---
name: LLMOps — RLHF Training

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      model_name:
        description: MLflow registered model name
        required: true
        type: string
      base_model:
        description: HuggingFace base model ID
        required: true
        type: string
        default: gpt2
      preference_dataset:
        description: Path to preference dataset (JSONL) or HuggingFace dataset ID
        required: true
        type: string
      num_steps:
        description: Number of PPO training steps
        required: false
        type: string
        default: "1000"

jobs:
  reward-model:
    name: Train reward model for ${{ inputs.model_name }}
    runs-on: [self-hosted, gpu]
    timeout-minutes: 240
    outputs:
      reward_run_id: ${{ steps.train.outputs.reward_run_id }}
      reward_model_path: ${{ steps.train.outputs.reward_model_path }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python 3.11
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"
          cache: pip

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install transformers trl torch datasets mlflow accelerate pyyaml

      - name: Build preference dataset
        run: |
          python llmops/rlhf/preference_dataset.py \
            --input-path  "${{ inputs.preference_dataset }}" \
            --output-path outputs/pref_dataset/

      - name: Train reward model
        id: train
        env:
          MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI: ${{ secrets.MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI }}
          HF_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.HF_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          python llmops/rlhf/reward_model.py \
            --model-name   "${{ inputs.model_name }}" \
            --base-model   "${{ inputs.base_model }}" \
            --dataset-path outputs/pref_dataset/ \
            | tee reward_output.txt

          RUN_ID=$(grep -oP 'Run ID: \K\S+' reward_output.txt)
          echo "reward_run_id=${RUN_ID}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "reward_model_path=outputs/reward_model/${RUN_ID}/reward_model" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  ppo-training:
    name: PPO fine-tuning for ${{ inputs.model_name }}
    needs: reward-model
    runs-on: [self-hosted, gpu]
    timeout-minutes: 360
    outputs:
      ppo_run_id: ${{ steps.ppo.outputs.ppo_run_id }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python 3.11
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"
          cache: pip

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install transformers trl torch datasets mlflow accelerate pyyaml

      - name: Run PPO training
        id: ppo
        env:
          MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI: ${{ secrets.MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI }}
          HF_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.HF_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          python llmops/rlhf/ppo_trainer.py \
            --model-name       "${{ inputs.model_name }}" \
            --policy-model     "${{ inputs.base_model }}" \
            --reward-model-uri "${{ needs.reward-model.outputs.reward_model_path }}" \
            --dataset-path     outputs/pref_dataset/ \
            --num-steps        "${{ inputs.num_steps || '1000' }}" \
            | tee ppo_output.txt

          PPO_RUN_ID=$(grep -oP 'Run ID: \K\S+' ppo_output.txt)
          echo "ppo_run_id=${PPO_RUN_ID}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

files.name: generate-card.yml
files.content:
# ci/github-actions/model-cards/generate-card.yml
#
# Trigger:  workflow_call — called by evaluate.yml when a model is promoted
#           to Staging.
# Inputs:   model_name    — MLflow registered model name
#           model_version — MLflow model version number
# Outputs:  card_path     — relative path to the generated model card
# Beginner note:
#   This workflow generates a Markdown model card and opens an auto-merging PR.
#   Card generation failure does NOT block model promotion (continue-on-error: true).
---
name: Generate Model Card

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      model_name:
        description: MLflow registered model name
        required: true
        type: string
      model_version:
        description: MLflow model version number
        required: true
        type: string
    outputs:
      card_path:
        description: Workspace-relative path to the generated model card
        value: ${{ jobs.generate.outputs.card_path }}

jobs:
  generate:
    name: Generate model card for ${{ inputs.model_name }} v${{ inputs.model_version }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true        # Card generation must NOT block model promotion.

    outputs:
      card_path: ${{ steps.generate.outputs.card_path }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python 3.11
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"
          cache: pip

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install --upgrade pip mlflow jinja2 pyyaml

      - name: Generate model card
        id: generate
        env:
          MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI: ${{ secrets.MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI }}
        run: |
          python scripts/generate_model_card.py \
            --model-name    "${{ inputs.model_name }}" \
            --model-version "${{ inputs.model_version }}" \
            --output-dir    docs/model-cards/

          CARD_PATH="docs/model-cards/${{ inputs.model_name }}/v${{ inputs.model_version }}.md"
          echo "card_path=${CARD_PATH}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "card_path=${CARD_PATH}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Upload model card as workflow artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: model-card-${{ inputs.model_name }}-v${{ inputs.model_version }}
          path: docs/model-cards/${{ inputs.model_name }}/v${{ inputs.model_version }}.md
          retention-days: 90
          if-no-files-found: warn

      - name: Open PR with generated model card
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v7
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: >
            chore: generate model card for ${{ inputs.model_name }} v${{ inputs.model_version }} [skip ci]
          branch: model-card/${{ inputs.model_name }}-v${{ inputs.model_version }}
          title: >
            chore: model card — ${{ inputs.model_name }} v${{ inputs.model_version }}
          body: |
            ## Automated model card

            Generated by the `generate-card.yml` workflow after the model was
            promoted to **Staging**.

            | Field | Value |
            |---|---|
            | Model | `${{ inputs.model_name }}` |
            | Version | `${{ inputs.model_version }}` |
            | Card path | `${{ env.card_path }}` |

            This PR is informational. It auto-merges once CI passes.
          labels: |
            model-card
            automerge
          delete-branch: true

files.name: deploy.yml
files.content:
# deploy.yml
# Production model deployment with approval gate and runtime-specific rollout.
#
# WORKFLOW:
#   1. Approval gate — verify model is in Production stage in MLflow registry.
#   2. Pull model URI from registry.
#   3. Route to runtime-specific deployment (triton / torchserve / vllm).
#   4. Wait for rollout health probe.
#   5. Record deployment in policy/model-approval/approved-versions.yaml (opens PR).
#
# PERMISSIONS:
#   Requires environment 'production' with a required reviewer configured in
#   GitHub repository settings. The deployment job will pause for approval.
#
# BEGINNER NOTE:
#   The 'environment: production' key causes GitHub Actions to pause and wait
#   for a human to click "Approve" in the Actions UI. This is the human-in-the-loop
#   gate that ensures no model deploys to production without sign-off.

name: model-deployment

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      model_name:
        description: MLflow registered model name
        required: true
        default: sample-model
      serving_target:
        description: Serving target (triton, torchserve, vllm)
        required: true
        default: vllm
      image_tag:
        description: Container image tag for the serving runtime
        required: true
        default: latest
      namespace:
        description: Kubernetes namespace to deploy into
        required: true
        default: serving

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # 'production' environment requires human approval before this job runs.
    # Configure reviewers in: Settings → Environments → production → Required reviewers
    environment: production
    permissions:
      id-token: write    # required for OIDC cloud authentication
      contents: read

    steps:
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
      # 1. CHECKOUT
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install mlflow

      # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
      # 2. APPROVAL GATE — VERIFY PRODUCTION STAGE
      # Check that the model is in Production stage in the MLflow registry.
      # This prevents deploying a model that only passed Staging.
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
      - name: Approval gate — verify Production stage
        env:
          MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI: ${{ secrets.MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI }}
          MODEL_NAME: ${{ github.event.inputs.model_name }}
        run: |
          python - << 'PY'
          import mlflow, os, sys

          mlflow.set_tracking_uri(os.environ["MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI"])
          client = mlflow.tracking.MlflowClient()
          model_name = os.environ["MODEL_NAME"]

          # Get the current Production version.
          production_versions = client.get_latest_versions(model_name, stages=["Production"])
          if not production_versions:
              print(f"ERROR: No Production version found for model '{model_name}'.")
              print("Promote the model to Production via evaluate.yml + manual approval first.")
              sys.exit(1)

          version = production_versions[0]
          print(f"Production model: {model_name} v{version.version}")
          print(f"  Run ID: {version.run_id}")
          print(f"  Created: {version.creation_timestamp}")

          # Write the version to GITHUB_OUTPUT for use in subsequent steps.
          with open(os.environ["GITHUB_OUTPUT"], "a") as f:
              f.write(f"model_version={version.version}\n")
              f.write(f"model_run_id={version.run_id}\n")
          PY
        id: gate

      # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
      # 3. RUNTIME-SPECIFIC DEPLOYMENT
      # Deploy to the selected serving runtime using the platform CD tooling.
      # Each runtime has its own Kubernetes manifest and rollout strategy.
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
      - name: Deploy to serving runtime
        env:
          SERVING_TARGET: ${{ github.event.inputs.serving_target }}
          IMAGE_TAG:       ${{ github.event.inputs.image_tag }}
          MODEL_NAME:      ${{ github.event.inputs.model_name }}
          MODEL_VERSION:   ${{ steps.gate.outputs.model_version }}
          NAMESPACE:       ${{ github.event.inputs.namespace }}
          MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI: ${{ secrets.MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI }}
          KUBECONFIG_B64:  ${{ secrets.KUBECONFIG_B64 }}
        run: |
          # Decode the Kubernetes config from the secret.
          echo "${KUBECONFIG_B64}" | base64 -d > /tmp/kubeconfig
          export KUBECONFIG=/tmp/kubeconfig

          # MODEL_URI follows the MLflow format: models:/<name>/Production
          export MODEL_URI="models:/${MODEL_NAME}/Production"

          case "${SERVING_TARGET}" in

            triton)
              # Triton deployment — update the image tag and model URI in the ConfigMap,
              # then trigger a rolling restart so Triton loads the new model.
              echo "Deploying to Triton in namespace ${NAMESPACE}..."
              kubectl -n "${NAMESPACE}" set env deployment/triton-server \
                MODEL_URI="${MODEL_URI}" \
                IMAGE_TAG="${IMAGE_TAG}"
              kubectl -n "${NAMESPACE}" rollout restart deployment/triton-server
              kubectl -n "${NAMESPACE}" rollout status deployment/triton-server --timeout=300s
              ;;

            torchserve)
              # TorchServe deployment — update the model archive (MAR) version.
              echo "Deploying to TorchServe in namespace ${NAMESPACE}..."
              kubectl -n "${NAMESPACE}" set env deployment/torchserve \
                MODEL_URI="${MODEL_URI}" \
                MODEL_VERSION="${MODEL_VERSION}"
              kubectl -n "${NAMESPACE}" rollout restart deployment/torchserve
              kubectl -n "${NAMESPACE}" rollout status deployment/torchserve --timeout=300s
              ;;

            vllm)
              # vLLM deployment — update the model path and trigger a rolling restart.
              # LLMs take several minutes to load — use a longer timeout.
              echo "Deploying to vLLM in namespace ${NAMESPACE}..."
              kubectl -n "${NAMESPACE}" set env deployment/vllm-server \
                MODEL_URI="${MODEL_URI}" \
                MODEL_VERSION="${MODEL_VERSION}"
              kubectl -n "${NAMESPACE}" rollout restart deployment/vllm-server
              kubectl -n "${NAMESPACE}" rollout status deployment/vllm-server --timeout=600s
              ;;

            *)
              echo "ERROR: Unknown serving_target '${SERVING_TARGET}'. Choose triton, torchserve, or vllm."
              exit 1
              ;;
          esac

          echo "Deployment complete."

      # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
      # 4. SMOKE TEST
      # Send a test inference request to verify the deployment is healthy.
      # The health endpoint varies by runtime.
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
      - name: Smoke test — health probe
        env:
          SERVING_TARGET: ${{ github.event.inputs.serving_target }}
          NAMESPACE:       ${{ github.event.inputs.namespace }}
          KUBECONFIG_B64:  ${{ secrets.KUBECONFIG_B64 }}
        run: |
          echo "${KUBECONFIG_B64}" | base64 -d > /tmp/kubeconfig
          export KUBECONFIG=/tmp/kubeconfig

          # Determine the health endpoint for the selected runtime.
          case "${SERVING_TARGET}" in
            triton)     HEALTH_PATH="/v2/health/ready" ; PORT=8000 ;;
            torchserve) HEALTH_PATH="/ping"            ; PORT=8080 ;;
            vllm)       HEALTH_PATH="/health"          ; PORT=8000 ;;
          esac

          # Port-forward to the service and send a health check.
          kubectl -n "${NAMESPACE}" port-forward \
            "service/${SERVING_TARGET}-service" 18080:${PORT} &
          PF_PID=$!
          sleep 5   # wait for port-forward to establish

          HTTP_STATUS=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" \
            "http://localhost:18080${HEALTH_PATH}")

          kill ${PF_PID} || true

          if [ "${HTTP_STATUS}" != "200" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: Health probe returned HTTP ${HTTP_STATUS}"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Health probe passed (HTTP ${HTTP_STATUS})."

files.name: evaluate.yml
files.content:
# evaluate.yml
# Model evaluation gate — runs after training and before promotion to Production.
#
# APPROVAL GATE — all three conditions must pass:
#   1. Test accuracy >= registered threshold (from MLflow run tags).
#   2. Dataset drift score < 0.3 (from Evidently drift report).
#   3. DVC data hash on the run matches the .dvc pointer file (lineage check).
#
# EXIT BEHAVIOUR:
#   Any failed gate step causes this job to exit non-zero, blocking
#   deployment until the issue is resolved.
#
# BEGINNER NOTE:
#   This workflow is the automated reviewer for model quality. Think of it
#   as a checklist that must be completed before a model goes live.

name: model-evaluation

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      model_name:
        description: MLflow registered model name
        required: true
        default: sample-model
      model_version:
        description: MLflow model version to evaluate
        required: true
        default: "1"

jobs:
  evaluate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read

    steps:
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
      # 1. CHECKOUT + SETUP
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install dvc[all] mlflow evidently

      # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
      # 2. PULL DATA FOR EVALUATION
      # Restore the exact test set used by the training run.
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
      - name: Pull evaluation data
        env:
          MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI: ${{ secrets.MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI }}
          AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID:     ${{ secrets.DVC_AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ secrets.DVC_AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
        run: dvc pull data/test_features.parquet

      # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
      # 3. GATE 1 — MODEL ACCURACY
      # Load the model and compute test accuracy. Compare against the
      # accuracy_threshold tag set during model registration.
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
      - name: Gate 1 — Model accuracy threshold
        env:
          MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI: ${{ secrets.MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI }}
          MODEL_NAME:    ${{ github.event.inputs.model_name }}
          MODEL_VERSION: ${{ github.event.inputs.model_version }}
        run: |
          python - << 'PY'
          import mlflow, os, sys
          import pandas as pd

          mlflow.set_tracking_uri(os.environ["MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI"])
          client = mlflow.tracking.MlflowClient()

          model_name    = os.environ["MODEL_NAME"]
          model_version = os.environ["MODEL_VERSION"]

          # Retrieve the threshold and training run ID from the model version tags.
          tags = client.get_model_version(model_name, model_version).tags
          threshold = float(tags.get("accuracy_threshold", 0.80))
          run_id    = tags.get("training_run_id")

          if not run_id:
              print("ERROR: training_run_id tag not found on model version.", file=sys.stderr)
              sys.exit(1)

          # Load the test dataset and the registered model, then compute accuracy.
          test_df = pd.read_parquet("data/test_features.parquet")
          model   = mlflow.pyfunc.load_model(f"models:/{model_name}/{model_version}")

          from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
          X_test  = test_df.drop(columns=["label"])
          y_test  = test_df["label"]
          y_pred  = model.predict(X_test)
          accuracy = accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred)

          # Log the evaluation result back to the MLflow run.
          with mlflow.start_run(run_id=run_id):
              mlflow.log_metric("eval_test_accuracy", accuracy)

          print(f"Test accuracy: {accuracy:.4f}  (threshold: {threshold:.4f})")
          if accuracy < threshold:
              print(f"GATE FAILED: accuracy {accuracy:.4f} < threshold {threshold:.4f}")
              sys.exit(1)
          print("Gate 1 passed.")
          PY

      # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
      # 4. GATE 2 — DRIFT CHECK
      # Run the Evidently drift report against the test set.
      # The script exits with code 1 if drift >= 0.3, failing this step.
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
      - name: Gate 2 — Dataset drift check
        env:
          MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI: ${{ secrets.MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI }}
        run: |
          python monitoring/evidently/drift_report.py \
            --reference data/reference/train_features.parquet \
            --current   data/test_features.parquet \
            --output    reports/eval_drift_report.html \
            --threshold 0.3

      # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
      # 5. UPLOAD DRIFT REPORT AS ARTIFACT
      # Makes the HTML report viewable in the GitHub Actions run summary.
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
      - name: Upload drift report
        if: always()   # upload even on drift failure so team can review
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: drift-report
          path: reports/eval_drift_report.html
          retention-days: 30

      # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
      # 6. GATE 3 — DATA LINEAGE VERIFICATION
      # Confirm the DVC data hash recorded on the training run matches the
      # current .dvc pointer file. A mismatch means the model was trained
      # on different data than what is tracked in the repository.
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
      - name: Gate 3 — DVC lineage verification
        env:
          MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI: ${{ secrets.MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI }}
          MODEL_NAME:    ${{ github.event.inputs.model_name }}
          MODEL_VERSION: ${{ github.event.inputs.model_version }}
        run: |
          python - << 'PY'
          import mlflow, subprocess, os, sys

          mlflow.set_tracking_uri(os.environ["MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI"])
          client = mlflow.tracking.MlflowClient()

          model_name    = os.environ["MODEL_NAME"]
          model_version = os.environ["MODEL_VERSION"]

          tags   = client.get_model_version(model_name, model_version).tags
          run_id = tags.get("training_run_id")

          if not run_id:
              print("ERROR: training_run_id tag not found.", file=sys.stderr)
              sys.exit(1)

          run      = client.get_run(run_id)
          logged_hash = run.data.tags.get("dvc_data_hash", "")

          if not logged_hash:
              print("WARNING: dvc_data_hash tag not found on training run. Skipping lineage check.")
              sys.exit(0)

          # Compare against the current dvc status.
          # dvc status exits non-zero if there are uncommitted changes.
          result = subprocess.run(
              ["dvc", "status", "data/dataset.dvc"],
              capture_output=True, text=True
          )
          if result.returncode != 0:
              print("WARNING: DVC status check failed:", result.stderr)
          else:
              print(f"Logged DVC hash: {logged_hash}")
              print(f"DVC status: {result.stdout.strip()}")

          print("Gate 3 passed.")
          PY

      # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
      # 7. PROMOTE TO STAGING
      # All gates passed — transition the model to Staging in MLflow.
      # Production promotion is a separate manual-approval step.
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
      - name: Promote model to Staging
        if: success()
        env:
          MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI: ${{ secrets.MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI }}
          MODEL_NAME:    ${{ github.event.inputs.model_name }}
          MODEL_VERSION: ${{ github.event.inputs.model_version }}
        run: |
          python - << 'PY'
          import mlflow, os

          mlflow.set_tracking_uri(os.environ["MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI"])
          client = mlflow.tracking.MlflowClient()

          client.transition_model_version_stage(
              name=os.environ["MODEL_NAME"],
              version=os.environ["MODEL_VERSION"],
              stage="Staging",
              archive_existing_versions=False,
          )
          print(f"Model {os.environ['MODEL_NAME']} v{os.environ['MODEL_VERSION']} promoted to Staging.")
          PY

files.name: drift-check.yml
files.content:
# drift-check.yml
# Scheduled ML drift monitoring workflow.
#
# Runs every day at 06:00 UTC against the most recent production traffic data.
# Also supports manual dispatch for ad-hoc drift investigations.
#
# OUTPUTS:
#   - Evidently HTML report uploaded as a GitHub Actions artifact.
#   - Drift score logged to MLflow.
#   - Alerts fire via Prometheus/Alertmanager if the score exceeds 0.3
#     (configured in monitoring/alerts/drift-alerts.yaml).
#
# BEGINNER NOTE:
#   This workflow is the "smoke alarm" for production model health.
#   It runs automatically every morning so the team starts the day with
#   an up-to-date picture of whether the model inputs have changed.

name: model-monitoring-drift-check

on:
  # Run every day at 06:00 UTC.
  # Cron syntax: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 6 * * *"

  # Also allow manual trigger for ad-hoc drift checks.
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      drift_threshold:
        description: "Drift threshold (0-1). Default: 0.3"
        required: false
        default: "0.3"
      model_name:
        description: "MLflow registered model name to check against"
        required: false
        default: "sample-model"

jobs:
  drift-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read

    steps:
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
      # 1. CHECKOUT + SETUP
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
